target.name: VDP_WriteAccumulatedWordStream
target.output: write each accumulated word twice to 0x00C00000

boundary_basis: D4 starts at 223 and the DBF loop is inclusive, producing 224 iterations.
D2 advances by two bytes per iteration and D0 is masked to nine bits before each pair of VDP data writes.
The routine ends at its direct RTS at 0x001B1E08-0x001B1E09, immediately before Terrain_DispatchFirstActorResponse.
